constraints: Change only Microsoft-hosted pool.vmImage labels. This retirement does not apply to self-hosted agents, Managed DevOps Pools, or VM scale sets.
The macOS 13 notice names macos-14, macos-15, or macos-latest. macos-14 has its own scheduled removal on 2026-11-02, so prefer macos-15 or macos-latest when the workload allows it.

steps.instructions: Change the reported pool.vmImage from macos-13 to macos-15 or macos-latest (the notice also allows macos-14; see the replacement).
steps.title: Retarget the hosted image

steps.instructions: Update every other azure-pipelines.yml pool, including stage and job pools, that still pins macos-13. Leave self-hosted pool names unchanged.
steps.title: Align other Azure Pipelines pools

verification.purpose: Lint .gitlab-ci.yml with gitlab-ci-lint, or .circleci/config.yml with circleci config validate, when the repository has that file. Azure Pipelines has no equivalent local validator: queue the pipeline and confirm the job uses the replacement vmImage.

sources.title: Upcoming Updates for Azure Pipelines Agents Images

rules.summary: The macOS 13 Ventura hosted image was retired on 2025-12-04. The Microsoft-hosted agents page states that date, and the Azure DevOps blog lists the same full retiral date.
rules.title: Azure Pipelines macOS 13 Ventura hosted image is retired

constraints: Change only Microsoft-hosted pool.vmImage labels. The macOS 14 schedule does not apply to self-hosted macOS 14 agents.
Move off macos-14 before the scheduled removal on 2026-11-02. The notice names macos-latest or macos-15.

steps.instructions: Change the reported pool.vmImage from macos-14 to macos-latest or macos-15 (see the replacement).
steps.title: Retarget the hosted image

steps.instructions: Update every other azure-pipelines.yml pool, including stage and job pools, that still pins macos-14. Leave self-hosted pool names unchanged.
steps.title: Align other Azure Pipelines pools

verification.purpose: Lint .gitlab-ci.yml with gitlab-ci-lint, or .circleci/config.yml with circleci config validate, when the repository has that file. Azure Pipelines has no equivalent local validator: queue the pipeline and confirm the job uses the replacement vmImage.

rules.summary: The macOS 14 Sonoma hosted image deprecation starts on 2026-07-06 and its scheduled removal is 2026-11-02, per Microsoft's hosted image deprecation schedule.
rules.title: Azure Pipelines macOS 14 Sonoma hosted image is scheduled for removal
